observed_mechanisms: Unnecessary escalations despite a current eligible offer.
Incorrect signed time differences and comparisons at exact-second boundaries.
Short explanations sometimes describe a passing offer while the saved action escalates, or admit lateness while the action books.
hypotheses_not_causal_findings: Action is serialized before the short reason in the common schema; early commitment may prevent later corrections from changing it.
Generic corrective-review instructions may encourage unsupported overturns.
Long procedural context can add distraction; this was not isolated by a context-length control.
limits: One small synthetic challenge set with one generation per configuration. All outputs ended normally and no request reached the 1536-token cap. Output token counts include adaptive thinking; they do not reveal private reasoning. The findings do not establish a general model ranking or a causal explanation of internal model behavior.
